2. m08-motion

The sole 12-frame authored animation: cube sweeps forward and right, then returns left as the camera moves inward and pans to follow.

Camera, motion and timing

Use the animated M08 Camera in scene M08Motion, not a camera override: location (5,-7,4) at frame 1, (4.5,-6.5,4.2) at frame 6 and (4,-6,4) at frame 12; keyed look directions aim at the cube plus 0.6 metres in Z.

Source frame 1: cube (-1,-0.35,0); camera (5,-7,4), looking at (-1,-0.35,0.6).
Source frame 6: cube (-0.4,0.65,0); camera (4.5,-6.5,4.2), panning toward (-0.4,0.65,0.6).
Source frame 12: cube (-1.2,0.25,0); camera (4,-6,4), turning toward (-1.2,0.25,0.6) to finish the return.

Scene: m08-scene / m08-scene-v1

Source range: 1–12 inclusive
FPS: 24/1
